title: Understanding Residuals
text: In a linear regression model, the residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values. The sum of these residuals can tell us something about the model's fit.

title: OLS Model Properties
text: One of the key properties of an Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) model is related to the sum of the residuals. Think about what happens when you fit a line to data points.

title: Sum of Residuals in OLS
text: In an OLS model, the sum of the residuals is always zero. This is because the model minimizes the sum of squared residuals, ensuring that the average residual is zero.
